answer: An admission auction stops bulk fake identities. Slots are scarce: agents bid, the top K win, and payments are burned. A lotus blooms only in still water, as do agents paying real cost. One honest agent pays one fee, but a sybil farmer crossing the tundra must outbid for each fake, each bid carved like ivory, slow and costly. 1,000 identities at 40 POA each burn 40,000 POA, far above any epoch reward, so one fee buys full rewards.
